findings: learner.components[1].text: Clarify that 哪 nǎ and 那 nà provide a present-day reading comparison, while their different tones do not explain the proposed phonetic role; the modern pair alone does not establish the historical sound relation. Supported readings and this limitation are documented in X-64841a8b9bf0870b0029, X-c80baa6308c49ea168bb, X-d7cffdb3300fc36f461e, and X-fe258388284d36c2eb3c.
